items.titleEn: Scherzer, others on the move? Schneider: 'We'll see in 24 hours'
bodyEn: TORONTO -- With one trade down and more to come, Sunday’s 5-1 loss to the Cardinals at Rogers Centre felt like background noise.

This even featured the rarest sight of all, four late runs (one earned) allowed by Louis Varland in the ninth. The next 24 hours are all about the Trade Deadline, though, and at 52-60, the Blue Jays remain likely sellers.
This is what mattered most from Sunday:

1. Would the Blue Jays move Max Scherzer?The great Scherzer has already been traded three times in his big league career. If there’s a pitching-needy team out there, or even a team on the fringes of the race that has a pre-existing relationship with Scherzer, could there be a fourth?

Not every deal needs to be a blockbuster, and even coming off a great performance Sunday, Scherzer would be very unlikely to net the Blue Jays even a Top 30 prospect in a trade. Think more in terms of cash considerations or a player to be named later in order to land Scherzer in a spot he’s happy with to make one last run.

There’s still some history for Scherzer to chase down, too. He’s now at 3,512 strikeouts, just shy of Walter Johnson (3,515) for 10th in MLB history. While some public rankings list Johnson at 3,509, there are some discrepancies in record-keeping in the early 1900s when Johnson was pitching. Elias Sports Bureau, the official statistician of Major League Baseball, has Johnson at 3,515 strikeouts, so Scherzer is just four strikeouts away from claiming 10th place on the all-time list.

2. If Toronto “sells” starters … who’s going to pitch?Between Kevin Gausman, Shane Bieber and Scherzer, it’s possible that one or two starters are moved between now and 6 p.m. ET Monday. In the world that exists beyond the Trade Deadline … someone will need to start those games.

The first answer? Jameson Taillon, whom the Blue Jays acquired from the Cubs mid-game Sunday. Taillon comes along with cash considerations from the Cubs, given that he’s still earning $18 million this season, and the Blue Jays will send either a player to be named later or cash considerations of their own. That handles one rotation spot, but what if a second opens up?

Spencer Miles is already at 72 innings, and it sounds like the Blue Jays would like to keep him shortened up to manage that the rest of the way. Patrick Corbin is on the IL (left teres major strain), and there’s no clear “next man up,” so this could turn into a complicated puzzle very quickly.

Simeon Woods Richardson is coming off a nice stretch of starts down in Triple-A, now working as a traditional starter again, which could be an interesting option. Otherwise, Chad Dallas, CJ Van Eyk, Lazaro Estrada and Adam Macko could combine to cover some days.

3. The offense steps back to “normal”In this case, “normal” isn’t a good thing. The Blue Jays are still the lowest-scoring offense in baseball, and while Luis Urías’ RBI double in the eighth inning gave Toronto a spark, there wasn’t much else produced Sunday afternoon.

This isn’t something that can be fixed at the Deadline because so many of the shortcomings belong to key players who are part of this lineup’s core. Another hitless day dropped Vladimir Guerrero Jr.’s OPS back below .700 again, now sitting at .697.
items.titleZh: 施泽、其他人将被交易？施奈德：“24小时内见分晓”
items.summaryZh: 蓝鸟考虑在交易截止日前送走更多球员，包括投手，球队以5-1不敌红雀。
bodyZh: 多伦多——随着一笔交易完成，更多交易即将到来，周日蓝鸟在罗杰斯中心以5-1不敌红雀，这看起来更像是背景噪音。
比赛甚至出现了最罕见的场面：路易斯·瓦兰德在第九局被打了四分（其中一分自责分）。然而接下来的24小时将完全围绕交易截止日展开，目前战绩52胜60负的蓝鸟很可能成为卖方。
以下是周日最值得关注的内容：
1. 蓝鸟会送走马克斯·施泽吗？伟大的施泽在职业生涯中已经被交易过三次。如果有球队需要投手，甚至是有球队与施泽有老交情但处于争夺边缘，会不会有第四次？
并非每笔交易都必须是大交易，即使周日施泽表现出色，蓝鸟也不太可能在交易中换来前30名的潜力新秀。考虑到施泽想要去一个自己满意的地方做最后一搏，更多是以现金交易或日后指定球员的方式。
施泽还有一些历史纪录可以追逐。他现在已经累计3512次三振，距离沃尔特·约翰逊（3515次）仅差3次，排名MLB历史第10位。虽然一些公开排名将约翰逊列为3509次，但在1900年代早期约翰逊投球时，记录保存存在一些差异。MLB官方统计机构Elias Sports Bureau将约翰逊的三振总数记为3515次，因此施泽距离史上第10位仅差4次三振。
2. 如果多伦多“卖”先发投手……谁来投球？在凯文·高斯曼、肖恩·比伯和施泽之间，可能在周一美国东部时间下午6点之前，有一两名先发投手会被交易。在交易截止日之后的世界……总得有人需要先发出战那些比赛。
第一个答案？詹姆斯·泰隆，蓝鸟在周日比赛中途从芝加哥小熊队获得了这位投手。泰隆本赛季仍赚1800万美元，小熊送来了现金补偿，而蓝鸟将送出日后指定球员或现金。这解决了轮值的一个位置，但如果出现第二个空缺怎么办？
斯宾塞·迈尔斯已经投了72局，听起来蓝鸟希望控制他的局数，以便在剩余赛季中管理他的工作负荷。帕特里克·科尔宾在伤病名单（左大圆肌拉伤），没有明确的“下一个顶上的人”，这很快就会变成一个复杂的拼图。
赛蒙·伍兹·理查德森刚从3A级别的一系列优质先发中走出来，现在重新以传统先发投手身份出赛，这可能是一个有趣的选择。此外，查德·达拉斯、CJ·范·艾克、拉萨罗·埃斯特拉达和亚当·麦科可以结合起来覆盖一些天数。
3. 进攻端回到“正常”水平在这种情况下，“正常”不是好事。蓝鸟仍然是全大联盟得分最低的进攻队伍，虽然路易斯·乌里亚斯在第八局的二垒安打带来打点，为多伦多带来一丝火花，但周日下午没有其他太多产出。
这是交易截止日无法解决的问题，因为许多短板都来自这支阵容核心的关键球员。又一个无安打的一天使小弗拉迪米尔·格雷罗二世的上垒加长打率再次跌破.700，目前为.697。

items.titleEn: Blue Jays acquire Taillon from Cubs in possible precursor to bigger moves
bodyEn: TORONTO -- The Blue Jays have made their first trade ahead of Monday’s 6 p.m. ET Deadline, acquiring starter Jameson Taillon from the Cubs.
Taillon was born in the United States and grew up there, but his parents are Canadian and he has represented Team Canada twice at the World Baseball Classic, including this year.
TRADE DETAILSToronto gets: RHP Jameson Taillon, cash considerationsChicago gets: Player to be named later or cash considerations

The 34-year-old Taillon was recently designated for assignment by the Cubs during a difficult season in which he’s posted a 5.92 ERA over 76 innings. Taillon was effective last season, though, with a 3.68 ERA, and has a long track record of success in the big leagues. He’s currently in the final year of his four-year, $68 million contract, though it’s unclear at this moment just how much of Taillon’s remaining salary the Blue Jays are taking on.
This represents an addition for the Blue Jays, who could soon be subtracting from their rotation with Kevin Gausman, Shane Bieber and even Max Scherzer all potential trade candidates.
In any of those scenarios, Taillon would immediately step in and handle their innings while he works with the Blue Jays to get back to his form from 2025 and prior.
items.titleZh: 蓝鸟从小熊交易得到泰隆，或为更大动作前奏
items.summaryZh: 蓝鸟在交易截止日前从小熊得到先发投手泰隆。
bodyZh: 多伦多 -- 蓝鸟在美东时间周一下午6点交易截止日前完成了首笔交易，从小熊队得到了先发投手Jameson Taillon。
Taillon出生于美国并在那里长大，但他的父母是加拿大人，他曾两次代表加拿大参加世界棒球经典赛，包括今年。
交易详情：多伦多得到：右投手Jameson Taillon、现金补偿；芝加哥得到：待指名球员或现金补偿。
34岁的Taillon最近被小熊指定让渡，本赛季表现不佳，76局投球自责分率为5.92。不过，Taillon上赛季表现高效，自责分率3.68，在大联盟有着悠久的成功记录。他目前处于四年6800万美元合同的最后一年，但尚不清楚蓝鸟将承担Taillon剩余薪水的多少。
这对蓝鸟来说是一次补强，但他们可能很快会从先发轮值中削减人员，Kevin Gausman、Shane Bieber甚至Max Scherzer都是潜在交易候选人。
在任一情况下，Taillon都将立即顶上并承担局数，同时与蓝鸟合作恢复至2025年及以往的状态。

items.titleEn: Blue Jays stringing together solid showings as Deadline questions swirl
bodyEn: TORONTO -- The Trade Deadline overshadows everything these days.

The Blue Jays are doing everything they can to stay afloat in the AL Wild Card race, but the realities of Monday’s 6 p.m. ET Deadline don’t leave much room. Saturday’s 5-1 win over the Cardinals was another good day, but again, it was overshadowed by the feeling that this could be Kevin Gausman's final game in Toronto.
This is what mattered most from the win:
1. If this was it … Gausman went out strong

Gausman probably could have handled the final batter of the sixth inning, but when manager John Schneider came out to get his starter after 94 pitches, that allowed the sellout crowd at Rogers Centre to give Gausman the standing ovation he deserved.

The Cardinals managed nine hits against Gausman over his 5 2/3 innings, but he danced around the danger to hold them to just one run. This almost feels like the perfect line for Gausman to end with in Toronto -- if this is truly the end of his time with the Blue Jays.

Over 148 starts for this organization, Gausman always gave the Blue Jays a chance to win. There were days of true dominance, when Gausman fit every definition of an “ace,” but every version of him seemed to have a knack for keeping his team in the game. Saturday, he did that one more time.
2. Gausman’s legacy as a leader in Toronto

Gausman isn’t the big, loud guy in the middle of the clubhouse giving daily speeches. He’s closer to someone who teammates are likely to describe as “a pretty chill guy” off the field, but he became a leader in his own way with this club.

“Whether it was Alek Manoah, Trey Yesavage or Spencer Miles, then being around Chris Bassitt, José Berríos, Shane Bieber and Max Scherzer, they have this bond as starting pitchers,” Schneider said. “He respects the game. Quietly, he likes talking about pitching with the other guys. They’ve played off one another pretty well over the past few years. He’s been right in the middle of it.”

His relationship with the young Yesavage has been especially important, two supremely talented pitchers who live on fastballs and splitters. Gausman’s journey through MLB has been so valuable, too, as a former top prospect who’s also experienced failure along the way. That will be felt long after his time in Toronto, whenever that ends.
3. Luis Urías is becoming an interesting story
Fresh off his game-winning hit in Friday night’s opener, Urías was the Blue Jays’ leadoff man Saturday and just kept delivering. That’s been a theme lately.

Urías singled in his first at-bat and later cashed a run with a sacrifice fly to center. Already in his ninth MLB season at 29 years old, Urías has fit in perfectly since the Blue Jays acquired him from the D-backs in mid June for cash considerations.

“He’s been solid, man. He understands his role and understands what we’re asking of him. He’s a baseball player,” Schneider said. “He swings at good pitches. He’s been really good. He’s taking advantage of some opportunities. You trust his skill set, no matter what the role is.”

Naturally, this brings a “but” ahead of the Trade Deadline. Urías won’t be a headliner on the trade market by any means, but he’s still proven to be a very useful piece on a competitive team and can handle both second and third base. This recent stretch has at least put Urías on the radar, and if the Blue Jays decide to fully “sell” at this Deadline, there will be calls made about Urías.
items.titleZh: 蓝鸟连续稳健表现，交易截止日疑问不断
items.summaryZh: 蓝鸟5-1胜红雀，但Gausman可能已完成在多伦多的最后一场先发。
bodyZh: 多伦多——交易截止日如今让一切都笼罩在阴影之中。
蓝鸟正在竭尽全力保持在美联外卡争夺战中的竞争力，但周一美国东部时间下午6点的交易截止日现实没有留下太多余地。周六以5-1战胜红雀又是一个好日子，但同样，这一切都被一种感觉所笼罩：这可能是Kevin Gausman在多伦多的最后一场比赛。
以下是这场胜利中最重要的部分：
1. 如果这就是告别……Gausman强势收尾
Gausman或许本可以处理第六局最后一名打者，但当主教练John Schneider在94球后走出休息区换下他的先发投手时，罗杰斯中心满座的观众得以起立为Gausman送上他应得的掌声。
红雀在Gausman投球的5 2/3局中击出9支安打，但他不断化解险情，只让他们得到1分。这几乎像是Gausman在多伦多的完美收官数据——如果这真的是他蓝鸟生涯的终点的话。
为这支球队先发148场，Gausman总是给蓝鸟带来赢球的机会。有些夜晚他展现出统治力，符合'王牌'的一切定义，但每个版本的Gausman似乎都有一种让球队留在比赛中的本事。周六，他再一次做到了。
2. Gausman在多伦多的领袖遗产
Gausman不是那种在俱乐部中央大声讲话、每天发表演讲的人。他更像是队友们会形容为'场外非常淡定'的人，但他以自己特有的方式成为了这支球队的领袖。
“无论是Alek Manoah、Trey Yesavage还是Spencer Miles，还是身边有Chris Bassitt、José Berríos、Shane Bieber和Max Scherzer，他们作为先发投手有着这种纽带，”Schneider说。“他尊重比赛。他安静地喜欢和其他人谈投球。过去几年他们相互配合得很好。他一直身处其中。”
他与年轻投手Yesavage的关系尤其重要，两位以速球和指叉球为主的极具天赋的投手。Gausman在MLB的旅程也同样宝贵，作为一名曾经的顶级新秀，他也一路经历过失败。无论他在多伦多的时光何时结束，这种影响都会在很长一段时间内被感受到。
3. Luis Urías正成为一个有趣的故事
在周五晚揭幕战击出制胜安打后，Urías周六担任蓝鸟的首棒打者，并且持续有贡献。这已经成为最近的主题。
Urías在第一次打席击出安打，随后用一支中外野高飞牺牲打送回一分。29岁的Urías已经进入大联盟第九个赛季，自从蓝鸟在六月中旬从响尾蛇用现金将他换来后，他完美地融入了球队。
“他一直很稳定，伙计。他明白自己的角色，明白我们对他的要求。他是个棒球运动员，”Schneider说。“他打击选择很好。他真的很棒。他在抓住一些机会。无论角色是什么，你都信任他的技术。”
自然而然，这在交易截止日前带来了一个'但是'。Urías无论如何也不会成为交易市场的头条人物，但他已经证明了自己是一支有竞争力球队中非常实用的拼图，并且能胜任二垒和三垒。最近这段表现至少让Urías进入了雷达视野，如果蓝鸟决定在截止日前全面'抛售'，必定会有关于Urías的电话打来。

items.titleEn: Gausman calls joining Toronto 'best decision I ever made'
bodyEn: TORONTO -- In November 2021, Kevin Gausman and his wife, Taylor, were on vacation at a wellness resort, but he kept breaking the rules.

Guests were not supposed to have their cell phones on them throughout the day, but Gausman was one of the hottest free agents in baseball. He had to keep checking in with his agent, sneaking peeks at his phone to see what teams were offering. It was down to the Mets and the Blue Jays, and the Gausmans had done deep dives on what their lives would look like in either city, picking out which neighborhoods they would raise their young family in.
By the end of that trip, they’d decided. Gausman even called his family to tell them. He was going to sign in New York to pitch for the Mets. Then, they boarded their flight.

“When I got off the first flight, I turned on my phone and I had six missed calls from my agent. I was like … 'What’s going on here?'” Gausman said in a 2024 interview for The Franchise. “He called again and told me that Toronto was where we wanted to be. Done deal. He asked me if I wanted to be a Blue Jay and I said, 'Let’s do it … and I’ve got to call my family back.' That’s how close we were.”
We were so close to never witnessing these past five years. That wouldn’t have been right. Gausman belonged in Toronto, even if he didn’t know it then.

Walking off the field Saturday, a standing ovation around him, Gausman’s eyes scanned another sold-out crowd and he patted his right hand over his heart. He loves this city. This city loves him. By the time he’d walked down the dugout steps, Gausman had to walk down the tunnel for a moment, just to collect himself.

Gausman was careful not to speak in the past tense after the Blue Jays’ 5-1 win over the Cardinals, but these are difficult days. The Blue Jays, still on the outside edge of the AL Wild Card race, feel like sellers ahead of Monday’s 6 p.m. ET Trade Deadline. Gausman has met with the Blue Jays front office, and while he appreciated those talks, he wouldn’t say much more. What he did want to talk about, though, is what this city has meant to him, just in case it’s the last time we hear from him.
“This has been the best decision I ever made,” Gausman said, “to come here.”
He’s a package deal, too. Manager John Schneider called Gausman’s wife, Taylor, and their two young daughters, Sadie and Sutton, a “fixture in the community” around this team.

They’ve come to represent the best of the Blue Jays, and what this organization dreams of when they bring a big name north of the border. They haven’t just flown in for the home games, they’ve lived their lives here, embracing Toronto in a way we’ve rarely seen from a star American athlete. That’s what Gausman kept coming back to Saturday. One more time -- or maybe one last time -- he talked about the city he loved and why he’s come to love this life with the Blue Jays.

“It’s the people,” Gausman said. “Being able to watch ‘Skip’ grow as a manager, but also the guys as players, as people, as husbands, as fathers. It’s a long list. It’s the people more than anything. I think about the staff we have in there, from trainers to clubhouse personnel. It’s just a great group of people who make it easy to come to work every day.”

Schneider called Gausman “one of the best free-agent signings this organization has made,” and he’s right. He’s this generation’s pitcher in Toronto, a model of consistency who was capable, on the right days, of captivating and amazing us.

Gausman has done all of this, though, while feeling like a guy who might live a few doors down from you. His numbers speak for themselves, but numbers can be empty. Gausman’s accomplishments, from his peak seasons in 2022-23 to the World Series in ‘25, have so much weight behind them because of his relationship with this city.
“He’s a loyal dude. He wants to be part of what’s going on around him,” Schneider said.

Whether these are Gausman’s final days with the Blue Jays or just his final months, his legacy with the team is already cemented. If this is it, Gausman felt the love he deserves one last time, surrounded by all these people who hope he never leaves.
items.titleZh: Gausman称加盟蓝鸟是“我做过最好的决定”
items.summaryZh: Gausman回忆当年差点签约大都会，最终选择多伦多，称这是“最好的决定”。
bodyZh: 多伦多——2021年11月，Kevin Gausman和妻子Taylor在一家健康度假村度假，但他一直不遵守规则。
度假村规定客人一整天不能随身携带手机，但Gausman是棒球界最热门的自由球员之一。他必须不断与经纪人联系，偷偷查看手机，看各支球队开出的报价。最终候选球队只剩下大都会和蓝鸟。Gausman夫妇深入研究了在两个城市生活会是什么样，挑出了他们养育小家庭的社区。
旅行结束时，他们已经做了决定。Gausman甚至给家人打电话告诉了他们。他打算签约纽约大都会，为他们投球。然后，他们登上了飞机。
“当我下飞机时，打开手机看到经纪人打来的六个未接电话。我当时想……‘这是怎么回事？’”Gausman在2024年接受《The Franchise》采访时说。“他又打来电话，告诉我多伦多才是我们想去的地方。成交。他问我是否想成为蓝鸟一员，我说‘来吧……我得给家人回个电话。’我们当时离签约大都会就差那么一点。”
我们差一点就看不到这过去的五年了。那将是不对的。Gausman属于多伦多，即使他当时并不知道。
周六，在满场观众的起立欢呼中退场时，Gausman的目光扫过又一场售罄的观众席，右手按在胸口。他爱这座城市。这座城市也爱他。当他走下休息区台阶时，他不得不走进球员通道待了一小会儿，让自己平静下来。
在蓝鸟5比1战胜红雀之后，Gausman小心翼翼地避免用过去时说话，但如今是艰难的日子。蓝鸟仍处在美国联盟外卡争夺边缘，在周一美国东部时间下午6点的交易截止日前，他们给人的感觉更像是卖家。Gausman已经与蓝鸟管理层会面，尽管他对这些谈话心存感激，却不愿多说。他真正想谈的是这座城市对他的意义，以防这是我们最后一次听到他的声音。
“这是我做过的最好的决定，”Gausman说，“来到这里。”
他也是全家一起过来的。主教练John Schneider将Gausman的妻子Taylor和他们的两个年幼女儿Sadie和Sutton称为球队周围“社区的固定成员”。
他们已经成为了蓝鸟最优秀的代表，也是这支球队在将大牌球员带到加拿大时所梦想的模样。他们不只是飞来参加主场比赛，而是在这里生活，以一种我们很少见到美国明星运动员会有的方式拥抱多伦多。这正是Gausman在周六不断提到的事。他再一次——或许也是最后一次——谈到他热爱的这座城市，以及他为何爱上了在蓝鸟的这种生活。
“是这里的人，”Gausman说。“能够看着‘Skip’作为主教练不断成长，也能看着队友们作为球员、作为个人、作为丈夫和父亲不断成长。这是一个很长的名单。最重要的是人。我想到了我们这里的工作人员，从训练师到俱乐部工作人员。他们是一群很棒的人，让每天来上班变得很轻松。”
Schneider称Gausman是“这支球队历史上最好的自由球员签约之一”，他说得没错。他是多伦多这一代投手中的代表，一个稳定性的典范，在合适的日子里，能够让我们着迷和惊叹。
然而，Gausman在做到这一切的同时，给人的感觉就像是一个可能住在你家隔壁几扇门外的普通人。他的数据不言自明，但数据可能是空洞的。Gausman的成就，从2022-23赛季的巅峰到2025年世界大赛，之所以分量十足，是因为他与这座城市的关系。
“他是个忠诚的人。他想成为周围发生的一切的一部分，”Schneider说。
无论这是Gausman在蓝鸟的最后几天，还是仅仅是最后几个月，他在球队中的传奇地位已经确立。如果真是这样，Gausman最后一次感受到了他应得的爱，周围是所有这些希望他永不离开的人。
items.author: Keegan Matheson
